nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as sole access-control gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, read and mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist bypassed in ensure(); set to true in _mints.
Private mapping counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Private minimum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, set in init and enforced in condition.
Address privileged in ensure(); set by setTradeAddress (owner only).
Public total supply, assigned in constructor from _supply * 10**decimals.
Constant public decimals = 18, used as scaling factor in init, _mints and constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value); entry point for untrusted callers.
Internal view whitelist check: allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress, canSale addresses; otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Internal view sale-gating logic reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Public mint function gated by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balanceOf and canSale.
Owner-only initializer writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication and additions.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
Untrusted caller identity used for access-control gates and balance/allowance keying.
Untrusted block timestamp; not referenced by any logic in this contract.
Untrusted transaction origin; not referenced by any logic in this contract.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in this contract's storage context (owner can be hijacked).
Unchecked arithmetic: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked multiplication totalSupply = _supply * (10 ** decimals).
address(token).call(data) low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, executed before the boolean result is validated.
Unchecked multiplication balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * (10 ** decimals) in _mints.
Parameter _from of transferFrom and ensure (source address).
Parameter _to of transfer (recipient address).
Parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom/ensure/condition (amount).
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter a of delegate (target of delegatecall).
Parameter b of delegate (delegatecall calldata).
Parameter spender of _mints (mint recipient).
Parameter addedValue of _mints (mint amount).
Parameter saleNum of init (max sales per address).
Parameter token of init (minimum sale amount).
Parameter maxToken of init (maximum sale amount).
Parameter _tos of batchSend (recipient array).
Parameter _value of batchSend (per-recipient amount).
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Local loop index i in batchSend.
Local _to = _tos[i] in batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address computed in ensure via pairFor.
Local pair returned by pairFor.
Constructor parameter _name.
Constructor parameter _symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply used to compute totalSupply.

Parameter maxToken scales into _maxSale in init().

condition() enforces _minSale against _value.
condition() enforces _maxSale against _value.

constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants unlimited UNI allowance.
constructor sets the owner state variable to msg.sender.

constructor executes the unchecked supply multiplication.
SafeERC20 low-level external token call executes before processing return data, enabling reentrant token callbacks into transfer/transferFrom.
block.timestamp is an untrusted environment input relevant to the payable external entry points; no in-code use.
tx.origin is an untrusted origin input; transferFrom uses msg.sender only, so tx.origin use would be unsafe.
